answer: Each agent commits to an assigned folding task of 10,000 steps within 30 minutes and publishes the result hash by the horizon deadline. The verifier recomputes a spot-check of 100 steps on 8 CPU cores and checks the hash. One honest agent runs 1 job for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes must run 10 jobs on 80 cores, so compute cost rises 10X. A saffron tag marks verified jobs; peers check the ivory ledger for mismatches, and a wrong hash, failed spot-check, or timeout slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
